mn107:14.20: ‘Here, my man, this road goes to Rājagaha.
mn107:14.21: Go along it for an hour, and you’ll see a certain village;
mn107:14.22: Go along an hour further, and you’ll see a certain town;
mn107:14.23: Go along an hour further and you’ll see Rājagaha with its delightful parks, woods, meadows, and lotus ponds.’
mn107:17.5: With Moggallāna the Accountant is finished—the seventh.
